issuer: the Central African Republic's authority in charge of transport (autorité compétente chargée des transports)
note: Read 2026-10-30: the Code communautaire de la route of the CEMAC (the Central African Economic and Monetary Community; the 2001 revised code, as its Secrétariat exécutif's text), which the Congo's Secrétariat général du gouvernement lists among its 18 consolidated codes in force ('Codes en vigueur', 'Code de la route 2001', sgg.cg). Its field of application: every vehicle registered in the territory of the CEMAC, its drivers and every road user. A licence is issued under the conditions the authority in charge of transport sets (art. 1); category B is the car of up to 3,500 kg (art. 2); candidates for B are 18 (art. 4, the age of the examination's candidates, held as the licence's); A1, A, B and G licences are valid 10 years, renewable for the same term after a satisfactory medical (art. 7). Art. 8: each member state recognises the others' licences, the host state keeping the right to test a holder who wants his licence transformed, so no exchange without a test is held. No fee is set in the code and none was read: fee null. The Central African Republic is named among the code's member states in its annex of registration marks ('République Centrafricaine RCA'), and the code applies by its own words to every vehicle registered in the CEMAC's territory: that is the reading that makes it the Central African licence's law (a reading to check: no Central African text was reached; transport.gouv.cf, the Primature's and the Assemblée's hosts didn't answer today, and no Central African act adopting or departing from the code was found). The copy read is the Congo's government's.

sources.title: CEMAC, Code communautaire de la route (2001), as published by the Secrétariat général du gouvernement of the Congo
sources.said: CODE COMMUNAUTAIRE DE LA ROUTE ... sont applicables à tous les véhicules et engins immatriculés sur le territoire de la Communauté Economique et Monétaire de l’Afrique Centrale ... délivré dans les conditions fixées par décision de l’autorité compétente chargée des transports ... Catégorie B : pour la conduite d’un véhicule automobile ayant un poids total autorisé en charge n’excédant pas 3.500 kgs ... Les candidats aux différents permis doivent être âgés de ... 18 ans pour les catégories B, F et G ... Les permis A1, A, B et G ont une validité de 10 ans. Ils sont renouvelables plusieurs fois pour la même durée, après une visite médicale satisfaisante. ... véhicules immatriculés en République Centrafricaine RCA
